metadata.case_name: LAM YIN MAN v. NG HING CHUEN AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.education_level: Completed DSE (May 2012); enrolled in Diploma of International Professional Beauty Therapist (one-year full-time) since around September 2012

source: provisional diagnosis was “Head injury and amnesia”.
She was seen at about 11.30 am. The attendance notes show that she was “alert” on arrival and she scored 15/15 on the Glasgow Coma Score suggesting that she was then fully conscious.

injuries.description: Multiple facial lacerations and resulting facial scars, including a 1-cm scar at the right corner of her mouth
source: There was a 0.5cm laceration over her right eyebrow, a 1-cm laceration over her right nasal bridge and a 1-cm laceration above her right upper mouth corner. The lacerations were cleaned and sutured.

There were multiple scars on the plaintiff’s face. But they are all faint and inconspicuous and can be covered up by cosmetic powder except the 1-cm scar which appears at the right corner of her mouth;
The treatments she had received were standard and appropriate. Her prognosis is good and the estimated cosmetic disability is 2%.
Her right upper incisor was missing and left upper incisor slightly loosened.
A temporary false tooth was put in for her missing incisor.
It is also reasonable for the plaintiff to have an implant for the upper right incisor which was knocked out during the accident. She has produced a quotation of $45,600.

injuries.description: Right thigh pain (no abnormality detected on MRI)
source: She also complained of right thigh pain after the injury but an MRI detected no abnormality.
She went to the A&E Department of the PMH more than once in January 2013 complaining of right thigh pain.
As a result of the accident, the plaintiff still feels intermittent right thigh pain aggravated by weather changes.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the hip or thigh, unspecified

manifestations.description: Multiple faint facial scars; visible 1-cm scar at right corner of mouth
Intermittent right thigh pain aggravated by weather changes
Low mood, depression, anxiety, insomnia, loss of self-confidence and self-esteem (psychiatric symptoms)

treatments_received: Attendance at A&E of Princess Margaret Hospital and admission to Department of Neurosurgery
Orthopaedic outpatient follow-up and MRI of right thigh
Temporary false tooth for missing incisor
Pharmacological psychiatric treatment at Tuen Mun Mental Health Clinic and follow-up sessions
treatments_future: Plastic surgical treatment to improve the facial scars (jointly recommended by plastic surgeons)
Dental implant for upper right incisor

losses.description: Multiple faint facial scars including a 1-cm scar at the right corner of the mouth affecting modelling work
Unable to resume work as a model due to visible facial scars; loss of modelling career prospects
Low mood, depression, anxiety, insomnia, loss of self-confidence and self-esteem (psychiatric symptoms)
